title: Real Heat Pump Running Costs: A Full Year of Data From 5 Real Homes
summary: UK installer shows a year of monitored running costs from five customer heat pumps and argues well-installed heat pumps cost less to run than gas boilers.

assertions.quote: in most cases that they're going to be cheaper than than a gas boiler to to run
It's because the installers who have put them in are bad.
this heat pump ran at a SCOP of 4.5 over the year.

verdicts.note: Top installs reach seasonal COPs near four, but large field trials such as the UK Electrification of Heat project measured medians closer to three.
Heat-pump-only cycle COPs were about 1.3 at 10F and 3.0-4.5 only in shoulder seasons; weather-normalized annual heat-pump-only COPs were 2.51-2.78 at three Minnesota sites, well short of four.
Across 12 monitored central heat pumps in cold northwest US climates, seasonal compressor-based heating COP averaged 2.5 (1.7-3.5) and system COP 1.5-2.9; none approached four.
